title: Finite-ring chart adjunction on the finite-Tor categories
statement:
Fix a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$. All schemes are separated of finite type over $k$, and all maps are $k$-morphisms [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital homomorphism of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$, and choose $N=\ell^n\geq1$ annihilating both. On either the ordinary etale or pro-etale site let $\mathcal C_{T,R}=D^b_{ctf}(T,R)$ mean the full category of constant-$R$ module complexes with bounded constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude: tensor with any degree-zero module sheaf has cohomology in one fixed finite interval [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude, det-sp-et-proet-adjunction-transfer]. Write $T_T=-\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. The finite Tate line is $R_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}R_T$ on the etale site and its comparison inverse image on the pro-etale site; $(d)$ denotes tensor with its $d$th tensor power [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist].
Let $e:U\to\mathbf A^d_Y$ be separated etale of finite type and put $g=p_de$. Choose compactifications with standing middle schemes [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. For $R=A,B$ set $H^{et}_{g,R}=e_R^*p_{d,R}^*(-)(d)[2d]$, and let $F^{et}_{g,R}$ and $F^{pro}_{g,R}$ be the chosen compact-support candidates [def-amb-etale-compact-support, det-sp-reduction-direct-image]. Give $F^{et}_{g,R}\dashv H^{et}_{g,R}$ the adjunction obtained from $De_{\Sigma!,R}\dashv e_R^*$ and the ordered affine-space adjunction by the graph-normalized left comparison [def-sp-etale-adjoint-chart-comparison, lem-amb-affine-space-top-trace]. Both functors restrict to $\mathcal C_{-,R}$. The exact comparison $C_{T,R}=\nu_T^*$ is an equivalence between the etale and pro-etale finite-Tor categories [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback, det-pe-finite-tor-comparison-noetherian]. For a quasi-inverse $Q_{Y,R}$, the functor $C_{U,R}H^{et}_{g,R}Q_{Y,R}$ is right adjoint to $F^{pro}_{g,R}$ and is canonically the geometric functor $H^{pro}_{g,R}=e_R^*p_{d,R}^*(-)(d)[2d]$. On $C_{Y,R}K$, its counit is
$$\widetilde\epsilon_{g,R,C_{Y,R}K}=C_{Y,R}(\epsilon^{et}_{g,R,K})\circ c_{g,R}(H^{et}_{g,R}K)^{-1},$$
with the canonical endpoint identifications; $c_{g,R}:C_{Y,R}F^{et}_{g,R}\xrightarrow{\sim}F^{pro}_{g,R}C_{U,R}$ is the fixed proper-and-open comparison [def-sp-fixed-compact-support-comparison]. There is a unique counit-preserving natural isomorphism $\theta_R:H^{pro}_{g,R}\xrightarrow{\sim}g_R^!$, where $g_R^!$ is the constructible Brown right adjoint [sk-prop-sf-rf-shriek-preservation].
